summary: Observe the share of local GET agents requests that succeed within 100 ms in a process-local seven-day window.

replay.detail: The observer has no durable state. A restart leaves the affected minutes unknown.

schema.detail: No persisted data or schema changes.

rules.detail: The observer measures requests without changing admission, fault routing or fleet coordination.

compatibility.detail: Existing requests and telemetry keep their behavior. Doctor performance output gains an optional agentsRequestSloShadow field.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal binary rollout.

manual.detail: No migration or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: An ordinary binary rollback removes the observer without changing durable state.
